query:
SELECT
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'auth.login_failed') AS "failed!",
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'auth.login')        AS "ok!",
            COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'auth.totp_failed')  AS "totp!"
        FROM audit_log
        WHERE ts >= now() - make_interval(hours => $1)
